title: Task Queue Simulator
description: Simulate a first-in-first-out task queue. ADD x inserts a task identifier at the back and PROCESS removes the task at the front. Every PROCESS operation is guaranteed to have a task available.
inputFormat: First line: q. Each following line is either ADD x or PROCESS.
outputFormat: For every PROCESS operation, print the processed task identifier on its own line.
hints: A queue removes elements in first-in-first-out order.

examples.input:
7
ADD 11
ADD 22
PROCESS
ADD 33
PROCESS
ADD 44
PROCESS
examples.explanation: Tasks are processed in the same order in which they entered the queue.
The oldest two tasks are processed first.
